voice: Calm, plain and honest. Short sentences. No hype, no exclamation-mark stacks.
Talk about routines and how it fits a day, not miracles.
Practical and transparent: dosage, form (bisglycinate, chelated), certifications.
Never make medical claims (cure, treat, prevent). Use 'support' language, as on the site.
